# duitku-go

> Go client for the Duitku Payment Gateway API v2. Standard library only, no
> dependencies. Signs every request with HMAC-SHA256 and verifies callbacks with
> a constant-time comparison.

Duitku is an Indonesian payment gateway. This package wraps its API v2:
payment method discovery, transaction creation, transaction status checks, and
callback handling.

## Install

```bash
go get github.com/fatkulnurk/duitku-go
```

## Entry point

```go
import "github.com/fatkulnurk/duitku-go"

client := duitku.NewClient(duitku.Config{
    MerchantCode: "DXXXX",
    APIKey:       "your-api-key",
    IsSandbox:    true,
})
```

## API

- `client.GetPaymentMethods(amount int) ([]PaymentMethod, error)`
- `client.CreateTransaction(request TransactionRequest) (*TransactionResponse, error)`
- `client.CheckTransaction(merchantOrderID string) (*TransactionStatusResponse, error)`
- `client.HandleCallback(w, r, handler func(*CallbackData) error)`
- `client.ParseCallback(r *http.Request) (*CallbackData, error)`
- `client.VerifyCallbackSignature(data *CallbackData) bool`
- `request.Validate() error`
- `duitku.ExpiryPeriodFor(paymentMethod string) (ExpiryPeriodLimits, bool)`
- `duitku.ValidateExpiryPeriod(paymentMethod string, expiryPeriod int) error`

## Signature scheme

Every operation uses `HMAC_SHA256(stringToSign, apiKey)` as lowercase hex, with
the API key as the HMAC key.

| Operation | stringToSign |
|---|---|
| Get Payment Method | `merchantcode + amount + datetime` |
| Create Transaction | `merchantCode + merchantOrderId + paymentAmount` |
| Check Transaction | `merchantCode + merchantOrderId` |
| Callback | `merchantCode + amount + merchantOrderId` |

MD5 and plain SHA256 are obsolete and not implemented.

## Payment method codes

`VC` credit card. `BC` `M2` `VA` `I1` `B1` `BT` `A1` `AG` `NC` `BR` `S1` `DM`
`BV` virtual accounts. `FT` `IR` retail. `OV` `SA` `LF` `LA` `DA` `SL` `OL`
e-wallet. `JP` e-banking. `SP` `NQ` `SQ` QRIS. `DN` `AT` paylater. `T1` `T2`
`T3` e-commerce.
